Mid 2024 I bought a new Lexus RX350h in Canada. It costs me $82000 with all the extras. 3m paint protection,  rust protection , ceramic coating and windshield insurance. That was 5k for all the extras. 

I was just getting tired of the payments and after putting the ego in check sold it for 69k 18 months later. 

the only thing that saved me was Toyota high resale value. 

the used market is horrendous.  Over priced older vehicles and always tacking on doc fees as high as $1800 for cleaning and reconditioning ext. 

I just got tired of it and bought two old Hondas. A civic and an Accord.  Both cars cost me 12k cad total and were around 100,000 km on them . 

the dealer salesman are snakes and always trying to upsell or push you into something you don't want or need. 

One dealer ran my credit twice without asking and ended up with two hard pulls on my credit score I didn't authorize. 

I'll take the older vehicles I paid cash for... No payments. Cheaper insurance and cheaper parts. 

Yes, they use more fuel but it still doesn't equal having these high finance payments  in the end even when repairs and maintenance issues arise .

The best part is not  having anymore depreciated assets.
The vehicles I have are  not going to be terrible losses when time to replace.
